easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat from step 2.
